The '''Mon Cala eel''', also known as the '''electric eel''', was a [[Color/Legends|green]], predatory [[Eel/Legends|eel]] species found on the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dac/Legends|Mon Cala]].<ref name="Prisoners" />

==History==
Some electric eels were used during the time of [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|Battle of Mon Cala]] by the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] as restraining and torture instruments in devices called [[Eel cage/Legends|eel cages]].<ref name="Prisoners" />
